S2.28.note: The output is a single latest-release summary plus a link to the GitHub releases page; no dated release list is rendered in the CLI. The TUI dispatches this command at apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:6724, and the link text comes from the Cargo.toml repository field.
steps: Start the CLI and wait for the chat prompt to appear.
Type /changelog and press Enter. /release-notes also works.
Look for a block titled Release notes with the line 'You are running ... v<version>'.

If a latest release is known, look for 'What's new in <version>: <summary>' and 'Release notes: <url>'. If not, look for 'Notes for each release: <repository>/releases', which points to the GitHub releases page.

Compare with Expected: a public changelog listing dated releases. The screen itself shows only the latest release summary and a link, with no dated list. The publish date is shown in the update status output, not here.
S2.28.where: In the chat prompt, type /changelog (or /release-notes) and press Enter

S2.35.needs: a signed-in Managed Cloud account; a Local or BYOK session does not send feedback
S2.35.note: No contact or support page exists in the CLI. The only agiworkforce.com/support text found is in a test assertion in apps/cli/src/errors.rs (around lines 1576-1582), not in product output; the MCP screen points to agiworkforce.com/integrations for help. The code path for the Expected page was not found, so this is the nearest in-app route.
steps: Sign in to the CLI with a Managed Cloud account. A Local or BYOK session does not send feedback.
In the chat prompt, type /feedback and a short message, for example: /feedback QA contact test, then press Enter.
Read the reply shown in the chat: a confirmation from the team's feedback inbox, or the failure line 'The team's feedback inbox did not confirm it. Try again in a moment.'
Type /feedback alone and press Enter to see the usage text that explains what is sent.
Compare with Expected: a contact or support page that lets a visitor reach the company. The CLI has no contact or support page; the closest is this in-app message to the team.
S2.35.where: In the chat prompt, type /feedback followed by a short message (or /bug) and press Enter
